description: Abstract class providing a template for data population from source to target objects, with locale support. It defines methods for setting and getting locale, and a populate method that delegates to an abstract createTarget method, intended for subclasses to implement specific target creation logic.

classes.name: AbstractDataPopulator
classes.description: An abstract class for converting data from a source object to a target object, with locale support. Implements DataPopulator interface and provides a common structure for concrete implementations.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Assigns a Locale object to the internal locale variable.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the current Locale object stored in the class.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts source data into a target object using the specified store and language, delegating to createTarget. Throws ConversionException if conversion fails.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to instantiate the target object.
